name: Wonder
implemented: Persona loadouts remain a separate system: three equip slots, fixed unique skills, and six legal transferable skill slots per Persona.
Cursed Ties remains a separate weapon record with one observed level-80, rank-6 profile and bounded panel stats.
The existing engine owns Cursed Ties Evil Eye candidate collection, configured per-hit/per-cast timing, owner-only 33% Attack condition, and its explicit unresolved-mechanic notices.
limitations: This record does not create a generic Wonder character replacement or merge Persona skills into a character kit.

Cursed Ties holder eligibility for the ally trigger, interaction of stated ailment accuracy with the 70% chance, reapplication behavior, and per-hit versus per-cast selection remain configuration- or evidence-gated.
No weapon panel stat is silently injected into Wonder's equipped totals.

sources.role: Persona slot legality and executable battle-skill selection
Observed Cursed Ties profile and evidence bounds
Existing Cursed Ties effect resolution and limitation reporting

integration.boundary: Keep Persona loadouts and Cursed Ties as their existing dedicated systems; character replacement modules must not duplicate or overwrite either.
